about.summary: Hi, I'm Rajat Sharma — a Full-Stack Developer passionate about crafting intuitive, high-performance, and visually appealing web applications. I specialize in building responsive and scalable user interfaces using Vue, React, Next.js, Bootstrap, and TailwindCSS. With a strong eye for design and a love for clean code, I enjoy turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions. Beyond coding, I'm always exploring new frontend trends, optimizing performance, and experimenting with modern web tools to deliver exceptional user experiences.
about.goal: To create digital experiences that are not only functional but also delightful for users.
about.years_of_experience: Software Engineer at Bold Technology (Feb 2026 - Present) & ex-Senior Software Engineer at Sopra Steria (July 2021 - Jan 2026)
interests: Interactive Data Visualizations & Graph Networks (yFiles, D3.js, Neo4j)

projects.name: Intelligent Network Analyzer
projects.description: A platform for telecom operators to monitor network health, analyze traffic data, and visualize system performance with a drag-and-drop interface.

projects.name: Tick-Tock Store
projects.description: A Vue.js-based e-commerce platform designed for showcasing and selling watches. Features dynamic product catalogs, search and filter functionality, and responsive UI design optimized for mobile and desktop. Leverages component-based architecture, Vue Router, and Pinia state management for seamless navigation and real-time updates.

projects.name: Tap 'n' Play
projects.description: A fun mini-games project built with React, featuring classic games like Tic Tac Toe, Quiz, and Play & Pause, showcasing interactive UI and state management.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: A responsive and interactive personal portfolio website built using React/Next.js to highlight professional skills, projects, and achievements. Designed with modern UI/UX principles, fast performance optimization, and SEO-friendly architecture.

projects.name: Chat with Rajat (AI Portfolio Assistant)
projects.description: An AI-powered conversational portfolio assistant that answers visitor and recruiter questions about Rajat's career, technical skills, and experience at Sopra Steria in real time.
